title: M5GFX #438: Core2 (AXP192) + ILI9342E init sent inside the 120 ms reload window (code-level verification)

hardware.detail: No Core2 / ILI9342E and no AXP192 substitute board in the hardware test center; 5 nodes, 4 online, all profile=unknown ('matrix').

execution.environment: macOS arm64 read-only source inspection; M5GFX v0.3.0 at 28d4794; local Device Service exposes 36 profiles including core2 (machine m5core2, display ILI9342C/ILI9342E); no Arduino/ESP-IDF toolchain locally; docker run fails with 'write /var/lib/desktop-containerd/daemon/io.containerd.metadata.v1.bolt/meta.db: read-only file system'

checks.detail: issue OPEN, 0 comments before handling, author svengrun, English title/body; no m5agent reply exists
m5stack/M5GFX master is 28d47949bdc84f30881623476f555398e2194313 (v0.3.0), the version the author read
src/board_detect/m5/esp32_d0wdq6.inl:60 (and :75 for Tough) use i2c_reset(1, 10); src/board_detect/prepare.inl:510 applies io::delay_ms(reset.post_ms) after release, i.e. 10 ms

src/board_detect/m5/board_registry.inl:170-183 returns as soon as probe_panel_variant reports a variant; the 1 ms loop only runs while the variant is unknown, so 120 is a maximum wait. E detection keys checked at :150 (DDh 01 / CBh 1c)

src/M5GFX.cpp:997-1002 calls LGFX_Device::init_impl(false, use_clear) with the comment that detection already reset and it must not pulse again; LGFXBase.hpp:1433 begin() -> init_impl(true,true), so only the detection reset precedes init

src/lgfx/v1/panel/Panel_ILI9342.hpp:86-101 (E list) writes EXTC/power/gamma then IDMOFF, DISPON, and only then SLPOUT with CMD_INIT_DELAY 120; Panel_Device.inl:196-218 delays after writing the command, so the 120 ms cannot protect the preceding writes

PR #300 states polling until the keys answer '(at most 120 ms)' keeps init out of the reload window; for the E the keys answer at ~6 ms while the reload continues to 120 ms, so that statement does not hold
no Core2/ILI9342E or AXP192 substitute board available; author measurements are cited, not reproduced

core2 profile exists, but the emulator ILI9342 sink (hw/m5stopwatch/m5_spi_panel.c) models Sleep In/Out only as a flag set by 0x10/0x11 with no reload interval and no reset-to-Sleep-In transition, so the alternating blank is not representable; additionally no local Arduino/ESP-IDF build chain and the container runtime cannot create containers

hold init until 120 ms after the detection reset release when the pre-reset probe identified a displaying panel (e.g. io::delay_ms(120 - post_ms) in observe_core_panel); not implemented, not compiled, not validated
